causal_erase.generation: Replay the frozen draw-command stream with exactly one sealed target BondBundle omitted; inpainting and painted white lines are forbidden.
causal_erase.selection: A second committed secret HMAC domain selects images and eligible target bonds before proposer execution.

execution.input_transport: one canonical JSON document on stdin
execution.output_transport: one canonical JSON document on stdout

matching.bond_matching: Global one-to-one matching over frozen per-bond visible-ink masks and renderer-derived terminal regions.
matching.display_semantics: Compare the rendered single/double/triple lane order; do not replace it with canonical SMILES or aromatic chemical equivalence.
matching.threshold_freeze: All overlap, endpoint, tie-break and graph-equivalence rules must be hashed before the secret seed is revealed.

permissions.custodian: May read source benchmark, old records and sealed GT; may not read or run proposer.
permissions.evaluator: May read frozen predictions and sealed GT only after run freeze; may not run proposer or change thresholds.
permissions.runner: May read frozen proposer and anonymous inbox only; may not read sealed data, source names or GT.
